CustomField.description:
If Has_Adjustment_After_Close_Won__c = TRUE, uses Max_ACW_App_Path_No__c.
If only Digital Media exists, uses Discount_Average__c: 0 % → Manager 1 - 30% → Manager > GM 30 - 80% → Manager > GM > VP 80 - 100% → Manager > GM > VP > DIR
If only TV Media exists, uses Max_App_Path_No__c.
If both Digital & TV exist, uses the highest value of Max_App_Path_No_Digital__c or Max_App_Path_No__c.
CustomField.label: Approval Path
